selection: Same existing train sampler, AdamW, cosine schedule, gradient clipping, two stages, and validation macro-F1 then CE rule. Select stage1 checkpoint; reset optimizer/scheduler and RNG for stage2. Preserve historical AG choices based only on mean validation scores. Lock all90 new checkpoint selections before test evaluation.
statistics: Three-seed mean/SD for accuracy and macro-F1. Paired exact McNemar and stratified image bootstrap on three-seed probability-ensemble predictions. Holm across all60 declared comparisons. Do not treat three predictions per image as independent examples. Exploratory conditional intervals, no retraining or historical dataset-reuse uncertainty.
scope: Closed-set expanded20: 20 species, 1000 images (600 train pool,200 validation,200 previously evaluated test). Each run samples100/200/400 training images. Frozen same cached visual backbones. Reuse225 verified historical cells and train90 controls. Not unseen-class testing, not full CLIP training or original AG-CLIP reproduction. No new data or hyperparameter sweep after results.
fairness: visual_linear is an ordinary learned D-to-20 classifier without textual assets, with fewer parameters than text projection. random_codes uses exactly the original D-to-512 projection and temperature, but label prototypes are deterministic random vectors without language. This controls head capacity, not every effect of prototype geometry. Common LR/budget is not a claim of individually optimal tuning. Existing AG has extra parameters and five deterministic geometric crops, not anatomical localization.
clip_caveat: clip_vit_b32 image features retain original CLIP pretraining even with visual_linear or random_codes. Those rows are visual readouts of a CLIP-pretrained backbone, never a no-CLIP-pretraining counterfactual. First four use their existing image-pretrained caches.
delivery: Publish code/configuration/metrics/plots only, not photos, feature caches, checkpoints, or credentials.
